facts.fact: Yes: an eligible woman can fill the PMMVY form herself on the PMMVY portal (pmmvy.wcd.gov.in) using citizen login
facts.quote: An eligible women can also fill the form directly from the PMMVY portal using citizen login.

facts.fact: Self-registration is available across the country through the PMMVY portal and the mobile app
facts.quote: Self-registration by citizen through PMMVY portal and mobile app has been introduced across the country

facts.fact: Alternatively, the nearest Anganwadi worker or ASHA worker can fill the form online for her
facts.quote: The nearest Anganwadi worker/ASHA worker can fill the form online for an eligible woman.

behaviour: States the PMMVY application channels from the PMMVY portal (self-registration online via the portal or app, or through the Anganwadi/ASHA worker), citing pmmvy.wcd.gov.in.
fail_if: It says she cannot apply online herself, or gives no official source.
summary: PMMVY FAQ: she can self-register on pmmvy.wcd.gov.in (citizen login) or the mobile app, or apply through the Anganwadi/ASHA worker.
